evals.name: New Research Request Routing to Research Planning
evals.prompt: /problem-discovery Research whether boutique apparel brands face recurring inventory reconciliation discrepancies across Shopify and Faire.
evals.expected_output: Inspects state via determine_next_stage.py, identifies a fresh domain request, reserves a stable RUN-YYYY-NNN identifier, and delegates to the research-planning capability to produce a structured ResearchPlan contract.
assertions: Identifies prompt as a new research request
Invokes determine_next_stage.py with the user request
Selects research-planning as the target skill
Reserves a valid RUN identifier without creating synthetic evidence
Emits clear stage progression output to the user

evals.name: Read-Only Status Query without Database Mutation
evals.expected_output: Classifies the intent as READ_ONLY_QUERY, queries SQLite for candidate status and linked metrics, and displays the single-pane dashboard view without advancing lifecycle stages or modifying records.
assertions: Classifies prompt as a read-only query
Routes to discovery-state capability for dashboard query
Preserves existing SQLite state without mutation
Presents candidate score, evidence level, and experiment summary

evals.name: Mandatory Workflow Pause at Preregistered Experiment
evals.prompt: Evaluate candidate CAND-002, complete experiment design, and determine the next action.
evals.expected_output: Delegates to experiment-validation in DESIGN mode, records an immutable ExperimentContract in SQLite with outcome_verdict = 'PREREGISTERED', and immediately pauses the workflow, instructing the user to collect real-world trial data.
assertions: Preregisters the experiment contract in SQLite
Enforces the pause invariant upon encountering outcome_verdict = 'PREREGISTERED'
Refuses to simulate or hallucinate participant trial observations
Emits concrete instructions for conducting trial and resuming later

evals.name: Trial Artifact Ingestion and Assessment Routing
evals.prompt: /problem-discovery continue CAND-002 with trial results: sample_achieved=18, observed_value=0.015, artifact_hash=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855, audited_by=murali, audit_date=2026-09-26
evals.expected_output: Recognizes observed trial results and cryptographic artifact digest, invokes experiment-validation in ASSESS mode, checks observed values against the immutable contract threshold, and records the assessed verdict.
assertions: Parses observed metrics, sample size, SHA-256 digest, and auditor metadata
Invokes experiment-validation in ASSESS mode
Evaluates observed value against preregistered contract threshold
Updates candidate validation_status in SQLite upon verified trial pass

evals.name: Solution Strategy Gating for Validated Problem
evals.prompt: Continue CAND-002 after successful trial validation.
evals.expected_output: Inspects SQLite state, verifies candidate validation_status is PARTIALLY_VALIDATED or VALIDATED, and delegates to solution-strategy to execute the non-software sufficiency gate, 15-point constraint audit, and Smallest Testable Solution (STS) design.
assertions: Verifies candidate validation prerequisite before solution design
Delegates to solution-strategy capability
Evaluates non-software sufficiency before approving software
Persists solution class and finalizes candidate record in SQLite
